create_continuous_distribution: create a continuous 1-dimensional uniform distribution over a factor key with min and max bounds
create_discrete_distribution: create a discrete distribution over a factor key with candidate values and optional sampling probabilities
build_mixture_distribution: build a mixture distribution that samples from component distributions with specified probabilities
build_intersection_distribution: build an intersection distribution that samples from overlapping component distributions using rejection sampling
build_product_distribution: build a product distribution combining component distributions with disjoint key sets
